overview: EGameBattleLogValueType labels the floating point counters that battle systems record and evaluate for objectives, story conversations, results, and rankings.

None.simple: A blank battle log slot that records nothing and never satisfies a condition.
None.technical: Underlying value 0. EvaluateLog returns false immediately for None. OnStartBattle excludes it from seeded map entries. BattleTalkSet treats every None slot as unconditional, and mission-task evaluation skips those slots.

NormalAttack_Damage.simple: Damage dealt by a basic attack.
NormalAttack_Damage.technical: Recorded from the hit point loss of an AttackType 1 attack. AddLogValue writes the raw damage Value to the attacker Send map and the receiver Receive map.

NormalAttack_Hit.simple: One landed hit from a basic attack.
NormalAttack_Hit.technical: Adds 1.0 for AttackType 1 on both the Send and Receive sides whenever damage resolution records the attack.

NormalAttack_Combo.simple: The longest basic attack combo counted for a character.
NormalAttack_Combo.technical: MaxLogValue stores the receiver combo count for AttackType 1 as a float, so repeated hits keep the largest observed combo.

NormalAttack_Finish.simple: A basic attack that finishes the target.
NormalAttack_Finish.technical: Adds 1.0 when bFlag2, the downed flag from damage resolution, is true for AttackType 1. AddLogValue ignores amounts of zero, so only the true case changes the log.

CursedEnergyAttack_Damage.simple: Damage dealt by a cursed energy attack.
CursedEnergyAttack_Damage.technical: For AttackType 2 and 3, adds the hit point loss to the shared cursed energy damage key for both Send and Receive. Type 2 also records the same amount under the numbered type 1 key, and type 3 under the numbered type 2 key.

CursedEnergyAttack_Hit.simple: One landed hit from a cursed energy attack.
CursedEnergyAttack_Hit.technical: Adds 1.0 for AttackType 2 or 3 on both Send and Receive sides. The same hit is also added under the matching numbered variant key.

CursedEnergyAttack_Combo.simple: The longest cursed energy attack combo counted for a character.
CursedEnergyAttack_Combo.technical: MaxLogValue stores the receiver combo count for AttackType 2 and 3 under this key, so repeated hits keep the largest observed combo.

CursedEnergyAttack_Finish.simple: A cursed energy attack that finishes the target.
CursedEnergyAttack_Finish.technical: Adds 1.0 when bFlag2, the downed flag from damage resolution, is true for AttackType 2 or 3. The same finish state is repeated under the matching numbered variant keys.

CursedEnergyAttack_Count.simple: The number of cursed energy attacks started.
CursedEnergyAttack_Count.technical: Adds 1.0 once when a cursed energy attack action starts, using numeric ID 9. The CursedEnergySense ranking record reads the total Send value and compares it with PrizeThreshold.

CursedEnergyAttack_1_Damage.simple: Damage from the first numbered cursed energy attack variant.
CursedEnergyAttack_1_Damage.technical: For AttackType 2, adds the hit point loss under this key in addition to the shared CursedEnergyAttack_Damage key, for both Send and Receive.

CursedEnergyAttack_1_Hit.simple: One hit from the first numbered cursed energy attack variant.
CursedEnergyAttack_1_Hit.technical: Adds 1.0 for AttackType 2 under this key alongside the shared cursed energy hit counter.

CursedEnergyAttack_1_Combo.simple: The longest combo in the first numbered cursed energy attack variant.
CursedEnergyAttack_1_Combo.technical: MaxLogValue stores the receiver combo count for AttackType 2 under this key.

CursedEnergyAttack_1_Finish.simple: A finish from the first numbered cursed energy attack variant.
CursedEnergyAttack_1_Finish.technical: Adds 1.0 when the AttackType 2 attack downs the target, using the same bFlag2 downed flag as the shared finish key.

CursedEnergyAttack_1_Count.simple: The number of first variant cursed energy attacks started.
CursedEnergyAttack_1_Count.technical: Adds 1.0 when IsCursedEnergyAttack1 recognises the first variant, using numeric ID 14. Result upload reads this round Send value from the player and writes it as an integer field.

CursedEnergyAttack_2_Damage.simple: Damage from the second numbered cursed energy attack variant.
CursedEnergyAttack_2_Damage.technical: For AttackType 3, adds the hit point loss under this key in addition to the shared CursedEnergyAttack_Damage key, for both Send and Receive.

CursedEnergyAttack_2_Hit.simple: One hit from the second numbered cursed energy attack variant.
CursedEnergyAttack_2_Hit.technical: Adds 1.0 for AttackType 3 under this key alongside the shared cursed energy hit counter.

CursedEnergyAttack_2_Combo.simple: The longest combo in the second numbered cursed energy attack variant.
CursedEnergyAttack_2_Combo.technical: MaxLogValue stores the receiver combo count for AttackType 3 under this key.

CursedEnergyAttack_2_Finish.simple: A finish from the second numbered cursed energy attack variant.
CursedEnergyAttack_2_Finish.technical: Adds 1.0 when the AttackType 3 attack downs the target, using the same bFlag2 downed flag as the shared finish key.

CursedEnergyAttack_2_Count.simple: The number of second variant cursed energy attacks started.
CursedEnergyAttack_2_Count.technical: Adds 1.0 when IsCursedEnergyAttack2 recognises the second variant, using numeric ID 19. Result upload reads this round Send value from the player and writes it as an integer field.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Damage.simple: Damage dealt by a super cursed energy attack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Damage.technical: For AttackType 4, adds the hit point loss under this key for both the attacker Send map and the receiver Receive map.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Hit.simple: One hit from a super cursed energy attack.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Hit.technical: Adds 1.0 when AttackType 4 lands. Result scoring, ranking records, and story mission orders read this value to award the matching super attack progress.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Finish.simple: A super cursed energy attack that finishes the fight.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack_Finish.technical: Adds 1.0 when bFlag2 shows that AttackType 4 downs the target. Story orders require at least 1.0 from allies before a super finish, and they fail when the enemy is out of stock and this value is zero.

SuperCursedEnergyAttack_SpecialAttackFin.simple: A super attack finisher recorded when its whole sequence ends.
SuperCursedEnergyAttack_SpecialAttackFin.technical: Numeric ID 23 is added to the finisher when bTeamDefeated is true at the end of the solo super sequence. No symbolic enum reference exists for this member in the reconstructed source.

Attack_Damage.simple: Total damage from all recorded attacks.
Attack_Damage.technical: After any classified attack, adds the hit point loss to the shared damage key for Send and Receive. Result scoring reads total Send damage for damage points and checks that Receive damage is zero for the no damage bonus. Ranking records compare both directions with PrizeThreshold, and the result snapshot copies total Send damage.

Attack_Hit.simple: One counted hit from any recorded attack.
Attack_Hit.technical: Adds 1.0 for every attack recorded through RecordAttackBattleLog, independent of AttackType, on both Send and Receive sides.

AttackAir_Hit.simple: One hit landed while the target was airborne.
AttackAir_Hit.technical: Adds 1.0 when bFlag, the in air action flag from damage resolution, is true. The record is written on both Send and Receive sides.

Attack_Assist.simple: One attack assist credited to a character.
Attack_Assist.technical: Adds 1.0 to the assistant Send map when knockout handling finds a character with the attacker index. Result scoring reads the total Send value for the Assist bonus.

FirstAttack.simple: The first attack of the round.
FirstAttack.technical: Adds 1.0 to the attacker Send map when StudioByte08 is 0xFF, then marks that byte with the attacker index. Mission tasks that use this key fail when the attacker team is not team 0.

FirstKill.simple: The first knockout of the round.
FirstKill.technical: Adds 1.0 to the killer Send map when StudioByte09 is still 0xFF, then stores the killer index. Result scoring checks a separate first kill character field for the FirstKill bonus.

HitPoint.technical: Tick writes the character current HP as a float to the Send map in both round and total log blocks. The value is refreshed every tick and can be read by table conditions.

HitPointRate.simple: Current health as a fraction of maximum health.
HitPointRate.technical: Tick writes current HP divided by maximum HP, with 0.0 when maximum HP is not positive. SumLogValues averages this key over the selected characters by dividing the summed value by the character count.

TimeLimit.technical: Tick writes DeltaTime plus TimeSystem Value08 to SendValues in seconds. Protracted story orders require the elapsed value to reach MissionOrder Value[0], and fast finish scoring requires it to stay at or below the score row threshold.

SpecialTagCombo_Count.simple: The number of special tag combos performed.
SpecialTagCombo_Count.technical: Numeric ID 33 is added once to each participating performer when the tag combo state starts, using BattleState06_PerformParam, which is 1.0. Result scoring and Binding Vow count checks read this value.

SpecialTagCombo_Damage.simple: Damage dealt by a special tag combo.
SpecialTagCombo_Damage.technical: For AttackType 5, adds the hit point loss under this key for both the attacker Send map and the receiver Receive map.

SpecialTagCombo_Hit.simple: One hit from a special tag combo.
SpecialTagCombo_Hit.technical: Adds 1.0 for AttackType 5. Story orders require at least 1.0 from allies, and ranking records and result scoring read the Send value.

SpecialTagCombo_Finish.simple: A special tag combo that finishes the target.
SpecialTagCombo_Finish.technical: Adds 1.0 when bFlag2 shows that AttackType 5 downs the target. Numeric ID 37 is also added to each performer when the tag combo sequence is lethal.

SpecialTagCombo_SpecialAttackFinish.simple: A special tag combo finisher recorded when its whole sequence ends.
SpecialTagCombo_SpecialAttackFinish.technical: Numeric ID 37 is added once to each performer when the special tag combo sequence reports bLethal. No symbolic enum reference exists for this member in the reconstructed source.

LinkCombo_Damage.simple: Damage dealt by a link combo.
LinkCombo_Damage.technical: Declared as a battle log key for link combo damage. No source producer, source consumer, or exported use was found, so the exact recording condition remains unresolved.

LinkCombo_Hit.technical: Numeric ID 39 is added to the performer Send map in OnLinkComboSucceeded. Result scoring and ranking records read this value for the LinkCombo bonus.

LinkCombo_Finish.simple: A link combo against a defeated receiver.
LinkCombo_Finish.technical: Numeric ID 40 is added once to the performer when the link combo receiver is valid and defeated. This is the finish condition recorded for link combos.

LinkCombo_CursedEnergyExp.simple: Cursed energy gained from a link combo.
LinkCombo_CursedEnergyExp.technical: Numeric ID 41 is added with OutGain, the gauge gain computed by AddLinkComboCursedEnergy. That gain starts from Global LinkCombo_CursedEnergyExp_Add times 0.01 times the level threshold difference, then applies character, buff, equipment, and Binding Vow modifiers.

DomainExpansion_Count.simple: The number of Domain Expansions performed.
DomainExpansion_Count.technical: Numeric ID 42 is added to the caster Send map both when an existing domain target sequence ends and when a new domain sequence begins. The end path requires the owner to have a DomainExpansion row and a valid previous target.

DomainExpansion_Return.simple: A Domain Expansion that replaced a rival domain.
DomainExpansion_Return.technical: Numeric ID 43 is added when a new domain starts over a previous valid target from a different team, or when an owner finishes another domain expansion from a different team. Result scoring reads this Send value for the DomainExpansionReturn bonus.

DomainExpansion_Overlap.simple: Concurrent Domain Expansions from the same team.
DomainExpansion_Overlap.technical: Numeric ID 44 is added when a new domain starts over a previous valid target from the same team, or when an owner finishes another domain expansion from the same team. Result scoring reads this Send value for the DomainExpansionOverlap bonus.

Debuff.technical: Adds 1.0 to the source Send map when a debuff is applied to a target and to the receiver Receive map when the debuff is received. Result scoring and ranking records read the Send total for the Debuff and Jammer bonuses.

DashGauge.technical: Adds the before minus after DashGauge difference to the Send map when dash gauge consumption begins and when it continues over time. Ranking records compare the total Send value with PrizeThreshold for TurboDash.

Guard.technical: Numeric ID 47 is added with amount 1.0 to the Receive map when a guard begins. Binding Vow checks read this key from Send and Receive, and the no guard score checks that the Receive total is zero.

JustGuard.technical: Numeric ID 48 is added to the receiver Receive map when JustGuard succeeds. Result scoring uses the Receive total for the JustGuard bonus, and ranking records compare that same total with PrizeThreshold.

GuardBreak.simple: A guard broken by an attacker.
GuardBreak.technical: Numeric ID 49 is added to the attacker Send map and the defender Receive map when a guard break action starts. Result scoring and ranking records read the Send total for the GuardBreak bonus.

Jump.technical: Numeric ID 50 is added to the character Send map when JumpBeginBase starts. CP_180 jump and boost paths also add it, and Binding Vow JumpCount checks read the total Send value.

Step.technical: Numeric ID 51 is added to the character Send map when Step starts. Binding Vow StepCount checks read the total Send value.

CursedEnergy_Exp.technical: Numeric ID 52 is added with a positive gauge increase when a buff raises the cursed energy level. Tick also keeps this Send key at the maximum of the current gauge and the logged gauge for both round and total blocks. Ranking records and result upload read the Send total.

CursedEnergy_Level.simple: The highest cursed energy level reached.
CursedEnergy_Level.technical: OnEvent13 writes the character clamped level, or 4 at maximum, into both Send maps. SumLogValues uses the maximum across evaluated characters for this key, and result scoring requires a total above 3 for MaximumOutput.

CursedEnergy_LevelMax.simple: Whether cursed energy is at its maximum level.
CursedEnergy_LevelMax.technical: Tick writes 4.0 when IsCursedEnergyLevelMax is true and otherwise keeps the largest clamped level already logged. The value is a Send side float refreshed each tick.

CursedEnergy_LevelUp.technical: Numeric ID 55 is added with the positive level difference when a buff raises the cursed energy level. Result scoring reads the total Send value for the LevelUp bonus, and Binding Vow checks read the same key.

ForceGauge.technical: Numeric ID 56 is added with OldStock minus NewStock to the Send map when a knockout credits the attacker and to the Receive map when the knockout is received. MissionTask data uses this key as a common failure objective with a Receive threshold of 3.

MovedDistance.technical: Tick converts ModeTravel2D to metres with a 0.01 multiplier and accumulates the delta into the total Send map while replacing the round value. Result scoring uses the total Send value for the Runner bonus.

WallBound.technical: Numeric ID 58 is added to the attacker Send map and the victim Receive map when a blow hits a wall. Result scoring and ranking records read the Send total for the WallBound bonus.

GroundBound.technical: Numeric ID 59 is added to the attacker Send map and the victim Receive map when a blow hits the ground. Result scoring reads the Send total for the GroundBound bonus.

BreakFall.simple: A fall broken after being launched.
BreakFall.technical: Numeric ID 60 is added to the character Send map when BreakFall starts.

BlowSpin.technical: Numeric ID 61 is added to the attacker Send map and the victim Receive map when BlowSpin launches the target.

Dead.technical: Numeric ID 62 is added to the knockout character Send or Receive map with the stock loss context. Result scoring reads Send for Defeat and checks that Receive is zero for NoDeath. Ranking records read Send for AceAttacker, and the result snapshot copies total Send knockouts.

AttackRange_Short.simple: An attack from the short range category.
AttackRange_Short.technical: Numeric ID 63 is added to the attacker Send map when an attack action starts with AttackSetRow AttackRangeType set to Short. Ranking records compare the total Send value with PrizeThreshold for ShortHitter.

AttackRange_Long.simple: An attack from the long range category.
AttackRange_Long.technical: Numeric ID 64 is added to the attacker Send map when an attack action starts with AttackRangeType set to Long. Ranking records compare the total Send value with PrizeThreshold for LongShooter.

AttackHitRange.simple: The distance of the longest recorded hit.
AttackHitRange.technical: GameBattleDamage calls MaxBattleLogValue with numeric ID 65 and the 3D distance between attacker and receiver, so the log keeps the greatest hit distance in world units. Result scoring compares this total Send value with the score row threshold for LongShot.

Revival.technical: Numeric ID 66 is added to the revived character Send map when the revival voice condition is met. Result scoring compares the total Send value with the score row threshold for ReturnToHell.

Provocation.technical: Adds 1.0 or 0.0 to the character Send map based on GameCharacter_IsProvocationLabel when a chat message is sent. Result scoring reads the Send total for the Provocation bonus.

Respect.technical: Adds 1.0 or 0.0 to the character Send map based on GameCharacter_IsRespectLabel when a chat message is sent. Result scoring reads the Send total for the Respect bonus.

NoOperation.simple: Time spent idle in the current idle action.
NoOperation.technical: Numeric ID 69 increases by DeltaTime each Idle tick while input is enabled and no attack flag is set. The value is reset when attack input is detected and when Idle ends.

NoOperationTotal.simple: The longest idle stretch in the fight.
NoOperationTotal.technical: Numeric ID 70 is stored with MaxLogValue from the accumulating IdleTime each idle tick, so it records the largest idle duration. Result scoring compares this Send value with the score row threshold for NoOperation.

BindingVowsPenalty.simple: A Binding Vows penalty stagger received.
BindingVowsPenalty.technical: Numeric ID 71 is added to the receiver Receive map when FGameCharacterAction_BindingVowsPenalty starts. Binding Vow DeadPenalty checks read this Receive total.

Unique.technical: Numeric ID 72 is added to the character Send map when CN_230 passive revival triggers or when CN_240 unique mode adaptation completes. The same key records different unique character events.

Invalid.simple: A sentinel for values that are not valid battle log measures.
Invalid.technical: Underlying value 255. EvaluateLog returns false before character selection, and OnStartBattle excludes it from seeded map entries. No source producer was found for this key.

notes: The underlying type is uint8. The declaration order matches the authoritative list from None through Unique, and Invalid is declared as 255. Source/AbramsDataTable/Public/EGameBattleLogValueType.h:6

Each character has two float maps keyed by this enum, SendValues and ReceiveValues, in both RoundLogs and TotalLogs. AddLogValue adds positive amounts, MaxLogValue keeps the larger value, and ResetLogValue writes zero. Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleSystems_B.cpp:291, Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleManager.cpp:1531, Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleManager.cpp:1553
OnStartBattle seeds every member except None and Invalid with zero in both maps, so a value can be evaluated before a producer writes it. Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleSystems_B.cpp:547

EvaluateLog rejects None and Invalid. SumLogValues takes the maximum for CursedEnergy_Level, averages HitPointRate over the selected characters, and sums every other key. Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleSystems_B.cpp:400, Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleSystems_B.cpp:427, Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleSystems_B.cpp:441

MissionTask and BattleTalkSet store ValueType in parallel arrays with TargetType, PassiveType, Value, and ConditionType. Consumers use ValueType.Num() as the condition count and read all arrays at the same index. Source/AbramsDataTable/Public/GameDataTableRow_MissionTask.h:20, Source/AbramsDataTable/Public/GameDataTableRow_BattleTalkSet.h:25, Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleSystems_B.cpp:660, Source/Abrams/Private/GameBattleStoryStates.cpp:273

Several producers pass numeric IDs to AddBattleLogValue, MaxBattleLogValue, ResetBattleLogValue, or GetBattleLogValue. The numeric IDs in this file were mapped through the authoritative enum list and checked against those call sites.
LinkCombo_Damage has no traced producer, consumer, or exported use in the available evidence, so it remains unresolved.

SpecialTagCombo_SpecialAttackFinish, SuperCursedEnergyAttack_SpecialAttackFinish, DomainExpansion_Count, DomainExpansion_Return, and DomainExpansion_Overlap are written through numeric IDs in the reconstructed source and have no symbolic enum reference there.
